acts.title: On the Beach
acts.summary: Hollis needs money and takes jobs. The Ottoline's lost cargo is back, and the grounding was no accident.

acts.title: Slack Water
acts.summary: Hollis gets close to Ashby from every side. She gets what she wanted and finds it isn't what she needed.

acts.title: The Turn
acts.summary: The bay empties, and everyone goes out to see what's on the bottom.

objectiveTypes.goto: Reach a marker on foot or any way.
objectiveTypes.drive_to: Reach a marker in a vehicle (the given one if 'vehicle' is set).
objectiveTypes.enter_vehicle: Get into a vehicle. 'vehicle': 'any' means any car; 'player' means the car the player arrived in.
objectiveTypes.collect: Pick up 'item'. 'carry': true means it is held and slows you.
objectiveTypes.deliver: Bring 'item' to the marker. 'options' makes it a branching choice.
objectiveTypes.lose_wanted: Get the wanted level to zero. 'trigger' can set the level first.
objectiveTypes.defend: Keep enemies off the marker for 'seconds'.
objectiveTypes.follow: Stay within 'distance' of 'target'. Being close is fine.
objectiveTypes.tail: Stay within 'distance' of 'target' without getting closer than 'min'.
objectiveTypes.escape: Leave the 'radius' around the marker, or reach the marker if a timer is set.
objectiveTypes.photo: Photograph 'subject'. Always optional, so missions work without the camera.

missions.title: Salt in the Wound
missions.brief: Meet Dez at the pier before the tide turns. Don't bring heat.
missions.summary: Dez pays $1,500 to drive a white van from the Gannet Truck Plaza across the causeway to Pier 9 before the tide turns. A patrol at the toll plaza runs the plate and Hollis loses it. At the pier a polite man in loafers takes the cargo: crates stenciled with the Ottoline's hold numbers, three years after they were lost at sea.

timer.label: Tide turns
timer.note: The mission clock covers 23:20 to 00:18 over the 600-second timer. The HUD reads about 11:42 PM once the van is picked up.

triggers.causeway: Player drives onto the Marlowe Causeway.
triggers.spotted: Player reaches the Causeway Toll Plaza. The parked patrol runs the plate. Wanted 1 and the toast.
triggers.van_damage: First hard collision in the van. Plays once.
triggers.heat_warning: Player is within 150 m of Pier 9 while wanted. Entering the drop circle while wanted fails with 'heat'.

objectives.note: Behind the car wash. Keys on the front tire.

objectives.text: Lose the patrol at the causeway.

toast.title: Wanted
toast.text: A patrol spotted you near the causeway.

dialogue.note: INT. GANNET TRUCK PLAZA, KITCHEN. 11:20 PM. Dish pit, steam, a weather radio on the shelf. Hollis lets the phone buzz twice before she answers. After 'I was.' she hangs the apron on the hook. EXT. behind the car wash: the van, keys on the front tire, and across the black water the island, tower tops still pink, the Port Salt cranes standing in the shallows like herons.

lines.speaker: forecast
lines.text: Winds northeast, ten to fifteen knots. High water, Marlowe Keys, twelve-eighteen.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: I've got a better one. High water's twelve-twenty.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: See? That's why I called you.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: White van behind the car wash. Keys on the front tire. Pier 9, before the tide turns.

lines.speaker: dez

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Everybody drives a white van. That's the point of a white van.

lines.text: Causeway unit, running a white van. Plate comes back to a dry cleaner that closed in 2019.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Hol. Tell me that's not you on the scanner.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: It's a white van, Dez. It's everybody.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Pier 9. Lights off for the last bit.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Captain's untying a line. Just the one.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Don't you come down here lit up.

dialogue.note: EXT. PIER 9, about 12:05 AM. The Tern idles at the T. Dez is barefoot on the planks, flip-flops in one hand. The crew unloads the van. Rafi steps off the boat in pressed linen and loafers, hands Dez an envelope, looks at Hollis, steps back aboard. Hollis sees the last crate's stencil: MV OTTOLINE, HOLD 3, 4 OF 11. As the Tern backs off riding low, two crates slide off the stern and float. Card: SALT IN THE WOUND. Complete. +$1,500.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: The report says those went in the water three years ago.

lines.speaker: dez

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: They'll come up at Tideline. Tower 4.

dialogue.note: EXT. SALT WORKS BOATYARD. The Ida May on blocks. Hollis on the deck in the dark, phone on the hatch cover.

missions.title: Chum
missions.brief: Lionel owes Dez for ice. Collect.
missions.summary: Dez hands Hollis a pistol 'for showing people' and sends her to collect $3,000 that Lionel Pike owes for ice. Two Lanyards are already in Lionel's office collecting for Bernie, and it turns into a fight in the Seagrape's courtyard. Lionel pays $800 and a story: he carries cash envelopes to Port Salt families for a Downtown company that wants their dock leases.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Lionel Pike owes me three thousand for ice.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: Oh. You're with Dez. Great. Everybody's here.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: I'll be in Room 12. Nobody goes in Room 12.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: I'll be honest with you, which I don't usually do.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: I carry envelopes to Port Salt. Cash. For dock leases.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: A company with a lot of glass.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: Here's eight hundred. Tell Dez the ice was mostly water.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: I can't put a story in the register.

missions.title: Flotsam
missions.brief: Boxes on Tideline Beach. Pruitt wants one. Don't tell her how.
missions.summary: The crates that slid off the Tern come ashore at Tower 4, right where Hollis said they would. Detective Odette Pruitt of the Wash-Up Desk wants one off the books before the Lanyards' cleanup crew gets there, and the crew gets there early. Hollis carries a crate off the beach through Safety and sets it down next to Pruitt on the third bench.

objectives.note: Carrying: no sprint. Drop it to fight, pick it back up.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: Nobody calls it that to my face.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: Boxes came up on Tideline Beach tonight. Ottoline boxes.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: That's what I figured you'd say.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: Bring me one. Don't tell me how.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: It's on the beach. That makes it the beach's.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: Cormorant Mutual paid forty-one million on these. Lost at sea.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: I sat in on your inquiry.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: I remember. You didn't say anything.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: Finder's fee. Ten percent of what I say it's worth.

fail.heat: You brought Safety to a cop.
fail.crate_lost: The crate went back in the water.

missions.title: Small Craft Advisory
missions.brief: Bernie wants a word about her box.
missions.summary: Bernie Szabo wants to know who took her box, and is almost pleased it was the pilot. Before she decides what to do about it, a Scrub crew comes over the fence with gas cans to burn Warehouse 6, and Hollis holds the door with the Lanyards. Rattled, Bernie shows her the Pier 8 barge log from the night of the grounding: eleven Ottoline boxes came off a Purcell Salvage barge at 3:40 AM, an hour before the ship hit the Knuckle.

objectives.note: The three carrying gas cans. If one reaches the wall, fail: warehouse_burned.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: You took one of my boxes off the beach.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: It was on the beach. That makes it the beach's.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: That's not how the beach works.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: You know the water. I could use somebody who knows the water.

lines.speaker: lanyard
lines.text: Bernie! Somebody's over the fence at Six!

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Scrub boys. From the mainland. Somebody paid their toll.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Pier 8 barge log. The night of your ship.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Eleven Ottoline boxes off a Purcell Salvage barge. 3:40 in the morning.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: I lift what comes. I don't read labels.

fail.warehouse_burned: Warehouse 6 is a parking lot now.

missions.title: Ice Run
missions.brief: Four hotels. The ice is melting.
missions.summary: The first job with wheels: Dez's ice truck, four Tideline hotels and a load that's melting. Dez rides along and tells Hollis about his brother Manny, who drove her pilot launch the night of the grounding, talked about a retirement plan, and left two weeks later in his skiff without a word.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Four hotels. Ice melts. That's the job.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: You have a guy for this.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: My guy got a DUI on a bicycle.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: I'll ride along. Don't hit anything. The ice can tell.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Manny drove your launch that night. You remember?

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: He talked about fishing the whole way out.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Two weeks later he's gone. Took his skiff. No note.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Week before, he tells me he's got a retirement plan. Twenty-six years old.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: I think he's on the mainland not calling his brother.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: Ice. Good. The machine's been making a noise like it knows something.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Wade Purcell won't tell you anything. He tows things. He doesn't talk.

missions.title: Soft Shoulder
missions.brief: Wade Purcell pulled something out of the water. Ask him what.
missions.summary: Hollis drives to Purcell Salvage & Tow to ask Wade about the barge and gets there at the same time as the Scrub, who have been sent to close Wade's mouth for good. She holds the yard, gets Wade into his own wrecker and takes him back across the causeway through a Safety roadblock. Hidden on the Ida May, Wade tells her he picked up eleven boxes on marker buoys an hour before she ever went aboard, paid in cash by a man who wears loafers on a boat, on a contract with Ashby Tidewater's name on it.

lines.speaker: wade
lines.text: I don't talk about that night. I tow things.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Somebody's about to talk about it for you.

lines.speaker: wade
lines.text: Wrecker. Keys are in it. They're always in it.

lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: Causeway units, wrecker inbound at speed. Yes, a tow truck. No, it's not towing anything.

lines.speaker: wade
lines.text: Eleven boxes on marker buoys at the outer anchorage. I picked them up an hour before you ever went aboard.

lines.speaker: wade
lines.text: Man who wears loafers on a boat. Cash. The salvage contract said Ashby Tidewater.

missions.title: Open House
missions.brief: Ashby's selling the waterfront tonight. Go look.
missions.summary: Ashby Tidewater is selling Port Salt Commons at an open house in the Meridian Tower. Hollis meets June Ashby, hears Calvin Ashby promise the waterfront real shade, and sees the site model: a marina where Pier 9 and Tideline Pier are now. Rafi recognizes her on the way out; she tails his car to the Seagrape and watches Lionel hand him an envelope.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Welcome to Port Salt Commons. Can I get you a water? It's local.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Port Salt gave this city its name. We're going to give it a future.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Marinas. Parks. A walkable waterfront. Real shade.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Hollis Vane. Our pilot. Rough seas, those were.

lines.speaker: rafi
lines.text: Ms. Vane. You're a long way from the water.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Lionel's in everything. He just doesn't know which thing.

missions.title: Do Not Disturb
missions.brief: Lionel has guests. He'd rather not.
missions.summary: Rafi has decided the Seagrape talks too much. Lionel calls from Room 12 with Tidewater Security in his lot; Hollis gets his ledger out of the office safe, holds the courtyard, and drives Lionel to hide in the walk-in at Ruelas Bait & Ice.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: Hi. It's Lionel. Pike. From the Seagrape.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: There are men in polo shirts in my lot.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: Nobody's been a guest here since 1998.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: There's a ledger in the safe. Everybody's in it. Including me, which I regret.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: Combination's my anniversary. Zero six one four.

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: They're shooting the ice machine. Why the ice machine?

lines.speaker: lionel
lines.text: The green one. It's older than my marriage and it's held up better.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: You brought Lionel to my bait shop.

missions.title: House Money
missions.brief: Ashby's money comes ashore Friday. Bernie wants it home.
missions.summary: Ashby washes his buyout cash through the card tables of the Gilded Gull, and every Friday it comes ashore at Northpoint Marina in an armored van. Hollis tails it into Midtown, Bernie's people stop it in the underpass, and Hollis drives the whole van to Warehouse 6 with three stars on it. Bernie needs someone to clean the money and asks where Lionel is. Hollis tells her.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Ashby washes his buyout money through the card tables on the Gilded Gull.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Every Friday it comes ashore in an armored van.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: And you want to rob it.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: I want to bring it home to Port Salt. With interest.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Stay back. Those guards get paid by the hour. They're in no hurry. Neither are you.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Twenty-five for you. Don't spend it on anything I'd notice.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Somebody has to wash the rest. Where's your motel man?

dialogue.note: EXT. SALT WORKS BOATYARD. The travel lift sets the Ida May in the water for the first time in three years. Hollis stays on the dock.

lines.speaker: tobias
lines.text: Twenty-two four. Storage, blocks, three years of me looking at it.

events.label: Ida May lien
events.note: Scripted. The Ida May goes in the water. Hollis does not leave.

missions.title: Public Comment
missions.brief: The Commission votes at eight. Get Moss there.
missions.summary: The Port Commission votes on Port Salt Commons at eight, and the swing vote, Commissioner Eldon Moss, has had the Scrub parked outside his house all week. Hollis follows Moss's car, stops the Scrub car boxing him in on Calder Street and drives him to the Old Customs House before public comment closes. Moss votes yes.

objectives.text: Get Moss to the Customs House.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Boat's in the water. So go.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Tide's been wrong for a week.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: Commissioner Moss is the swing vote on the Commons. The Scrub's been parking outside his house.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: I'm a cop with ninety days left. I can't be seen near a commissioner.

lines.speaker: moss
lines.text: I appreciate this. I really do. Is that blood?

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: He just wanted to be asked nicely.

reward.note: Moss pays. It's an envelope he brought for someone else.

missions.title: Fair Weather
missions.brief: Ashby wants a word on his boat.
missions.summary: Ashby invites Hollis aboard his yacht, the Fair Weather, and offers her license back in exchange for the Ottoline's missing recorder capsule, which he says Manny Ruelas called him about once, before he left town. As a show of good faith she breaks into Harbor Station, takes the crate she gave Pruitt out of the evidence cage, and hands it to Rafi on Pier 9.

objectives.note: Stealth-light: avoid officers' sight cones. Seen means three stars, not failure.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: She's never been past the Knuckle. Can't risk it.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: The night of your grounding, the ship's recorder lost its capsule. Little orange box.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: I know what a capsule is.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Manny Ruelas called me about it, a week or two after. Wanted money. Then he left town.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: You find that box, and the pilots' board finds its way to reinstating you. I fish with two of them.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Then you're a dishwasher with a sailboat. I'm not threatening you. I'm describing you.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Small favor first. Detective Pruitt has a crate of mine. I'd like it back.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: I'm not doing it for him.

missions.title: Undertow
missions.brief: Manny had a shack on the Stilts. The road's only there at low water.
missions.summary: Dez takes Hollis out the Bar Road at low water to Manny's shack on the Stilts, where they find his tide table with the grounding night circled and a position near the Knuckle. Tidewater Security followed them out; they hold the shack and race the flood tide back. At Tideline Pier, Ruelas Bait & Ice is burning, Lionel is dead in the walk-in, the ledger is gone, and a witness is pointing at the pilot.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Ashby thinks Manny took the capsule off my ship.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Manny had a shack on the Stilts. Road's only there at low water.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Low water's 9:14. We've got an hour either side.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: He circled the night we hit. And a position. Two hundred yards off the Knuckle.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: That's not where he hid it, Dez. That's where they met him.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: If they followed us out here...

lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: All units, Tideline Pier. Fire and a body. Witnesses are saying the pilot.

lines.speaker: newsreader
lines.text: Public Safety is asking for help finding Hollis Vane, a former harbor pilot, after a fire on Tideline Pier.

lines.speaker: newsreader
lines.text: In other news, the marine forecast calls for strong north winds through the weekend.

fail.tide: The tide came in. It does that.

missions.title: Toll
missions.brief: Get back on the island. Pruitt's on the third bench.
missions.summary: Hiding at Wade's, Hollis hears the marine forecast: three days of north wind will push the bay out to the lowest water in forty years, Saturday night. Wade puts her in his wrecker with a car on the hook and sends her through the Safety checkpoint on the causeway. On the third bench in Palm Square, Pruitt and Hollis finally tell each other the truth.

objectives.note: Speeding or weapons out near the checkpoint fails the mission.

lines.speaker: forecast
lines.text: North winds twenty-five to thirty, three days. Water levels well below predicted. Extreme low water Saturday.

lines.speaker: wade
lines.text: Marine forecast's calling a blowout. Bay's going to empty out.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Lowest water in forty years. Saturday, 2:10 in the morning.

lines.speaker: wade
lines.text: Wrecker's got a car on the hook. Sit low. Look bored.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Tideline. Somebody parked on a hydrant.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: I say yes. It's a problem.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: I wrote the inquiry finding. The Chief handed me the conclusion. I typed it.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: I don't think you did Lionel.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: Then bring me something that floats.

missions.title: Gated Community
missions.brief: June Ashby wants out. She's bringing her father's laptop.
missions.summary: June Ashby wants out and says she has proof: her father's laptop, with the original salvage contract and the buoy positions from the night of the grounding. Hollis crosses Bellwether Bridge, gets June and the laptop out of the Ashby house past Tidewater Security, and loses them in Downtown. June says her father and Rafi will be on the flats Saturday at dead low with a salvage crew, and asks whether her own name will be in it.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: June Ashby called me. She wants out. She says she has the salvage contract and the buoy positions.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: I'm the only cop her father doesn't fish with.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Ms. Vane. I'd offer you a water.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Nothing in this house is local.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: He's going out on the flats Saturday. Him and Rafi and a salvage crew.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: When this comes out, is my name in it?

missions.title: Last Shift
missions.summary: Ashby gave the Commons security contract to Tidewater Security instead of the Lanyards, and tonight his crews come with a bulldozer to clear Longshore Hall. Bernie admits she sold Lionel for a contract that never existed; Hollis stays anyway and holds the hall while the Lanyards get their families and their records out. Bernie gives her the keys to a yard truck that sits high enough for the flats, and tells her where Rafi will be tomorrow night.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: I told Rafi where Lionel was.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: He promised us the Commons. Security, parking, all of it.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Gave it to the polo shirts.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: I'm not sorry. I'm broke. It looks the same from outside.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: They brought a bulldozer. To a union hall. At night.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Yard truck. Sits high. It'll do the flats if you don't stop.

lines.speaker: bernie
lines.text: Rafi's at Pier 9 tomorrow night, loading his salvage crew.

missions.title: Man Overboard
missions.brief: Rafi's at Pier 9. So is the ledger.
missions.summary: Dez wants Rafi; Hollis wants the ledger. They tail Rafi from Northpoint Marina to Pier 9, where his salvage crew is loading pumps and lights, and take the pier apart. Cornered at the end, Rafi tells Hollis who gave him Manny's hiding place three years ago; Dez doesn't deny it, and Rafi goes off the end of Pier 9.

objectives.note: In Rafi's car at the head of the pier.

dialogue.note: After 'We talked.' Dez fires once. Rafi goes off the end of Pier 9 into the channel. Nobody looks over the rail.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: It's an island, Rafi. I'm never far.

lines.speaker: rafi
lines.text: You want to know who told me where Manny was?

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: They said they'd talk to him. Scare him. That's all.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Twenty thousand. They paid me twenty thousand and I kept the shop.

lines.speaker: dez
lines.text: Three years I told myself he ran to the mainland.

reward.note: From the glovebox of Rafi's car.

missions.title: Dead Low
missions.brief: Dead low at 2:10. Everything's coming up.
missions.summary: Saturday, 2:10 AM. The bay is gone, and half of Marlowe Keys is out on the flats with flashlights looking at what the water gave back. Hollis drives Bernie's yard truck out to the Knuckle, finds Manny's skiff in the mud and the orange capsule under the bow seat, and holds the wreck against Ashby's salvage crew until the tide turns. Then the water comes back fast, Ashby makes his last offer, and she has to get off the flats and decide who gets the box.

objectives.note: Stopping on soft mud bogs the truck for 3 seconds.

lines.speaker: walker
lines.text: There's a car out here. A whole car.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Forty years since anybody saw the bottom.

dialogue.note: Manny is still in the skiff. Hollis puts her jacket over him before she opens the bow seat.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Under the bow seat. Rafi never looked.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Ms. Vane! I brought a salvage crew. You brought a truck.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: Hollis. I'm at the landing. It's just me.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: You've got about six minutes of dry ground. Let's not waste them.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: License. Money. Your name back. All I want is the box.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: So's mine. That's why it's expensive.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Water's coming. It always comes back fast.

fail.tide: The tide came back. It always does.
fail.capsule_lost: The box went back in the water.

endings.title: Bring It Up
endings.summary: Hollis gives the capsule to Pruitt. The recorder plays in Harbor Station. Ashby is arrested on the Bar Road landing with his shoes in the mud. Hollis gets her hearing, and this time she talks. Her license comes back. Dez pleads to his part in Manny's death and gets probation; nobody asks too hard about Rafi. Manny is buried on the mainland, facing the water. June takes over Ashby Tidewater, settles with the city and builds the project anyway, renamed Ruelas Landing.

epilogue.note: INT. HARBOR STATION, WASH-UP DESK. Dawn. Pruitt plays the capsule on a borrowed reader. Hollis listens to herself.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Captain, you'll put her on the Knuckle.

epilogue.note: EXT. BAR ROAD LANDING. Ashby in cuffs, ankle deep in the mud the tide left.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: These shoes cost more than your car.

epilogue.note: INT. PILOTS' BOARD HEARING. Same room as three years ago. This time she talks.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: I said port twenty. I said it twice. Then I didn't say anything for three years. That part's on me.

epilogue.note: EXT. MARLOWE CHANNEL, DUSK. Months later. Hollis climbs a pilot ladder up the side of a container ship at the sea buoy and brings it in past the Knuckle, which is only water again. On Pier 9 a crew is pulling the pilings for Ruelas Landing. Dez is fishing off what's left. He lifts a hand. Card: LOWTIDE. Everything washes up eventually.

endings.title: Let It Sink
endings.summary: Hollis gives the capsule to Ashby and tells Pruitt there was nothing out there but Manny. Ashby drops the box off the Fair Weather into the channel. The board reinstates Hollis in a two-minute meeting. Port Salt Commons goes up, Dez leaves for the mainland, Pruitt retires with the case open. A year later, at low tide, a kid finds something orange at Tower 4. When Ashby finally goes down, he names everyone he ever paid, starting with her.

epilogue.note: EXT. NORTHPOINT MARINA, the next night. Ashby drops the capsule off the stern of the Fair Weather.

lines.speaker: hollis
lines.text: Don't put it in the channel.

epilogue.note: EXT. TIDELINE BEACH, TOWER 4. One year later, low tide. A kid pulls something orange out of the wrack line. INT. WASH-UP DESK. A new detective plugs it in.
INT. SHIP'S BRIDGE, NIGHT. Hollis is bringing a ship in when her phone buzzes. Pruitt is retired, but she still hears things. Card: LOWTIDE. Everything washes up eventually.

activities.name: Wash-Up
activities.summary: Forty Ottoline crates and other oddities on the beaches and flats. Some can only be reached near low tide. The Wash-Up Desk pays a finder's fee for each.
activities.reward: $100 each. All forty: Pruitt's tide table on the HUD.

activities.name: Ice Route
activities.summary: Timed ice deliveries to Tideline hotels in the bait-shop truck. Every bump costs melt. Ends when the shop burns.
activities.reward: $150 to $400 a run, tips for a clean truck.

activities.name: Courier Jobs
activities.summary: Photo jobs for the Keys Courier, the city's last paper: four pages, two of them tide tables. A pelican on a Safety cruiser. A commissioner's car in a loading zone. The fountain running.

activities.name: Lifts
activities.summary: Night jobs in the Stacks: find the container on Bernie's list, take what's on it, get out without waking port security.

activities.name: Catwalk
activities.summary: Night fishing off the causeway with the regulars. Sell the catch to Dez. The anglers trade rumors that point to other jobs.

activities.name: Dominoes
activities.summary: Bet against the old men under the banyan. What they say between hands changes with the story, usually a day before it happens.
activities.reward: Win or lose up to $500 a game.

activities.name: Night Desk
activities.summary: Cover the Seagrape's front desk for Lionel. Check in strange guests, answer the phone, don't open Room 12.
activities.reward: $60 a shift and whatever's in the lost and found.

activities.name: Dish Pit
activities.summary: Arlo will take Hollis back at the Gannet Truck Plaza. He takes everyone back. Honest work, pays like it.

ambient.text: Tide's out. You can smell the whole city.
They're calling it Port Salt Commons. Nobody I know can afford common.
My cousin found a radar on the beach. He doesn't have a boat. He just has a radar now.
Don't park on Tideline after ten. Safety tows you, then sells you the tow.
That fountain hasn't run since I was in high school.
Is it hot, or is it me? It's both, isn't it.
Causeway's backed up. Somebody's fishing in the left lane.
Thirty years on this island. Been to the beach twice. Both times by accident.
Sunset was nice. I watched it on the hotel channel.
Low tide tonight. Bring a flashlight and a reason.

radio.text: Causeway unit, running a white van. Plate comes back to a dry cleaner that closed in 2019.
Marine Two, Harbor Station. Something floating off Tower 4. Wake up the Wash-Up Desk.
Shots fired on Tideline Avenue. The Seagrape. Again.
Suspect on foot through Palm Square, last seen by the dominoes. The dominoes are not cooperating.
Lost visual in the Stacks. Every container's blue. Requesting a search of the area.
Suspect vehicle is a wrecker. Yes, a tow truck. No, it's not towing anything. Now it is.
Safety Response is rolling. Midtown units, hold your intersections.
All units, the Gannet Draw is going up. Causeway is closed. Nobody leaves the island.

characters.name: Hollis Vane
characters.role: Protagonist. Former Marlowe Bar Pilot, now a dishwasher at the Gannet Truck Plaza.
characters.look: Faded work shirt with the pilots' patch picked off, hair tied back with whatever was nearby.
characters.voice: Flat, exact, few words. Gives times to the minute.
characters.want: $22,400 to get the Ida May off the blocks and sail out past the Knuckle for good.
characters.need: To say out loud what happened on the Ottoline, and to stay.
characters.flaw: She would rather be blamed than argue. She says yes to whoever asks hardest.
lines: High water's 12:18. After that, nobody's leaving.
I'm not a criminal. I'm between licenses.
I didn't put that ship on the Knuckle. I was just the one standing on the bridge.
It'll come up at Tower 4. The current hooks there.
I say yes. It's a problem.

characters.name: Desmond 'Dez' Ruelas
characters.role: Owner of Ruelas Bait & Ice on Tideline Pier. Small-time fixer. Hollis's oldest friend.
characters.look: Fishing shirt, reading glasses on a cord, barefoot whenever he can get away with it.
characters.voice: Quick and warm. Makes every job sound like a favor he's doing you.
characters.want: Keep the shop, keep his people out of jail, and believe his brother ran off to the mainland.
characters.secret: Three years ago he told Rafi where Manny was hiding, for $20,000 and a promise they would only talk to him. He used the money to keep the shop.
lines: You're late. Tide's already turning.
It's for showing people.

characters.name: Calvin Ashby
characters.role: Antagonist. Chairman of Ashby Tidewater and chair of the Port Commission.
characters.look: Linen suit, real sunburn, a smile he's had professionally maintained.
characters.voice: Warm and folksy. Never says a number out loud. Talks about the city like it's a boat he's captaining.
characters.want: Port Salt Commons built, and to be remembered as the man who saved the waterfront.
characters.secret: He staged the Ottoline grounding: cargo dropped early for the insurance, the channel blocked long enough to break Port Salt and buy it cheap.
lines: I'm not threatening you. I'm describing you.
Port Salt gave this city its name. We're going to give it a future.

characters.name: Detective Odette Pruitt
characters.role: Marine Recovery and Found Property, Marlowe Keys Public Safety. Everyone calls it the Wash-Up Desk.
characters.look: Rain jacket in all weather, reading glasses pushed up, a face like a bait shop after closing.
characters.voice: Patient and level. Asks the second question first.
characters.want: To close one case properly before she retires.
characters.secret: She wrote the inquiry finding that blamed Hollis. The Chief handed her the conclusion and she typed it.
lines: Nobody calls it that to my face.
Bring me something that floats.

characters.name: Bernadette 'Bernie' Szabo
characters.role: Night crane operator, union steward at Longshore Hall, and the boss of the Lanyards.
characters.look: Hi-vis vest over a church blouse, a lighter she never uses.
characters.voice: Blunt, union-meeting cadence. Counts things out loud.
characters.want: Keep the docks working and her people paid, whoever is paying.
characters.secret: She craned the 'lost' Ottoline boxes off a barge an hour before the ship grounded, and has fenced them for Ashby for three years.
lines: I lift what comes. I don't read labels.
I'm not sorry. I'm broke. It looks the same from outside.

characters.name: Rafi Castellan
characters.role: Ashby Tidewater's Director of Community Relations. The muscle.
characters.look: Pressed linen, loafers with no socks, even on a boat.
characters.voice: Quiet and polite. Uses your title. Never raises his voice because he's never had to.
characters.want: Ashby's trust, and a house on Bellwether Key of his own.
characters.secret: He killed Manny Ruelas at a meeting off the Knuckle and sank the skiff. He never found the capsule.
lines: Ms. Vane. You're a long way from the water.
Nobody ever is.

characters.name: Lionel Pike
characters.role: Owner of the Seagrape Motor Inn on Tideline Avenue. Launders Ashby's buyout cash.
characters.look: Short-sleeved dress shirt, a tie with fish on it, a handkerchief that's given up.
characters.voice: Nervous, over-explains, talks like a front desk.
characters.want: Keep the Seagrape, which hasn't made money since 1998.
characters.secret: The motel's best customer is a shell company. Room 12 has been booked for three years and nobody has ever slept in it.
lines: I'll be honest with you, which I don't usually do.
Nobody's been a guest here since 1998.

characters.name: June Ashby
characters.role: Vice president of sales at Ashby Tidewater. Calvin's daughter.
characters.look: Sales-gallery blazer, sandals in her bag for after.
characters.voice: Brochure-perfect until it isn't. Then very direct.
characters.want: Out from under her father, with the company.
characters.secret: She wrote the insurance claim for the Ottoline cargo. She is turning on her father to take his chair, not to make anything right.
lines: Can I get you a water? It's local.
When this comes out, is my name in it?

characters.name: Wade Purcell
characters.role: Owner of Purcell Salvage & Tow on the mainland.
characters.look: Coveralls tied at the waist, a sunburned neck, a dog that doesn't like him.
characters.voice: Slow mainland drawl. One sentence at a time.
characters.want: To be left alone and to pay off his barge.
characters.secret: He picked up the eleven boxes on marker buoys before the Ottoline reached the pilot, for cash. He kept the receipts.
lines: Keys are in it. They're always in it.
I don't talk about that night. I tow things.

characters.name: Manny Ruelas
characters.role: Dez's younger brother. Ran the pilots' launch. Missing three years.

characters.name: Commissioner Eldon Moss
characters.role: Port Commission swing vote. Always a yes.

characters.name: Captain Teodor Brask
characters.role: Master of the Ottoline. Heard only on the recorder.

characters.name: Chief Warren Tibbs
characters.role: Chief of Marlowe Keys Public Safety. Fishes with Ashby.

characters.name: Arlo
characters.role: Night cook at the Gannet Truck Plaza. Hollis's boss.

characters.name: Tobias Fenn
characters.role: Runs the Salt Works Boatyard. Holds the lien on the Ida May.

characters.name: Marine Forecast
characters.role: The recorded voice on the weather radio.

characters.name: Public Safety Dispatch
characters.role: Police radio.

characters.name: Safety Officer
characters.role: Generic Public Safety officer.

characters.name: Lanyard
characters.role: Generic Lanyards dockworker.

characters.name: Scrub Boy
characters.role: Generic Scrub crew member.

characters.name: Tidewater Security
characters.role: Generic Ashby Tidewater security guard in a polo shirt.

characters.name: Commission Clerk
characters.role: Reads the roll at the Port Commission.

characters.name: Witness
characters.role: Generic bystander.

characters.name: Flats Walker
characters.role: Locals out on the flats at dead low with flashlights.

characters.name: Courier Radio
characters.role: The late news on the Keys Courier's radio slot.

characters.name: Kid on the Beach
characters.role: Finds things.

characters.name: Helmsman
characters.role: At the wheel of whatever ship Hollis is bringing in.

districts.name: Downtown
districts.vibe: Glass towers that look at the water all day and never get wet.
ambient: Flag halyards slapping on empty poles

districts.name: Midtown
districts.vibe: Where the people who work Downtown live, and the people who work Tideline sleep.
ambient: Window units dripping on the sidewalk
A ballgame on a radio behind a screen door

districts.name: Palm Square
districts.vibe: The city's front porch. Half the benches face the founder. Half face away.

districts.name: Port Salt
districts.vibe: The city's working hands. Salted, cracked and about to be sold.
ambient: A ship's horn out in the channel

districts.name: Tideline
districts.vibe: Pastel hotels with their best years in the brochure.
ambient: A lounge piano two hotels down

districts.name: The Causeway
districts.vibe: Four miles of concrete between what the island wants and what it needs.
ambient: Wind with nothing to stop it

districts.name: The Mainland
districts.vibe: Everything the island doesn't want to look at, at a fair price.

districts.name: The Salt Flats
districts.vibe: Half the day it's water. The other half it's evidence.

places.name: Gannet Truck Plaza
places.note: 24-hour truck stop and diner at the mainland foot of the causeway. Hollis washes dishes here for Arlo. There is a car wash out back.

places.name: Purcell Salvage & Tow
places.note: Wade Purcell's tow yard on the barge canal. A safehouse after Soft Shoulder.

places.name: The Mill
places.note: A burned-out lumber mill in the pines. Where the Scrub crew sleeps, when it sleeps.

places.name: Gannet Deepwater Terminal
places.note: The new mainland port, half built. Ashby holds a stake through a company with a different name.

places.name: Marlowe Causeway
places.note: Four miles of low concrete across Marlowe Bay, from the island's east shore to Gannet Landing.

places.name: Causeway Toll Plaza
places.note: Island end of the causeway. A patrol parks here for the air conditioning.

places.name: Gannet Draw
places.note: The drawbridge span near the mainland end. At five stars Safety raises it and the island is closed.

places.name: Causeway Catwalk
places.note: The fishing catwalk along the south rail. Regulars, buckets, radios.

places.name: Pier 9
places.note: The last numbered pier: old timber at the south end of Port Salt, where the docks give way to Tideline. Too shallow for container ships. Shrimp boats and people who don't want a receipt.

places.name: End of Pier 9
places.note: The T at the far end of Pier 9, over the channel edge.

places.name: Piers 1 to 8
places.note: Container berths under the gantry cranes locals call the Herons.

places.name: Pier 8 Barge Berth
places.note: Where barges unload. The night crane is Bernie's.

places.name: The Stacks
places.note: The container yard. Every aisle looks the same, which is the point.

places.name: Warehouse 6
places.note: The Lanyards' warehouse. Three years of Ottoline cargo went out its back door.

places.name: Longshore Hall
places.note: The union hall. Folding chairs, a coffee urn, Bernie's office.

places.name: The Ballast
places.note: Dockworkers' bar on Salt Works Road. Cash only. Busy at shift change.

places.name: Gate 3
places.note: The main truck gate into the port.

places.name: Harbor Station
places.note: Public Safety's Marine Unit: boat slips, a radio room and the Wash-Up Desk.

places.name: Harbor Station Evidence Cage
places.note: A chain-link room in the basement of Harbor Station where found property waits for an owner.

places.name: Salt Works Boatyard
places.note: Boats on blocks behind chain-link. The Ida May has been here three years.

places.name: Salt Works Road
places.note: The road along the old salt ponds down to Pier 9.

places.name: The Salt Works
places.note: The brick salt works and evaporation ponds the district is named for. Closed since before anybody's parents.

places.name: Tideline Avenue
places.note: The beachfront strip of pastel low-rise hotels and palms.

places.name: Seagrape Motor Inn
places.note: Lionel Pike's motel. Pink, two stories. The sign has been off since the bulb went.

places.name: Seagrape Office
places.note: Front desk, a bell nobody rings, the safe behind the key board.

places.name: Seagrape Courtyard
places.note: A drained pool and the ice machine.

places.name: Seagrape Room 12
places.note: Booked for three years by a company that never checks in.

places.name: Hotel Coquina
places.note: The best hotel on Tideline Avenue, which isn't saying much. The Hospitality Association meets in its bar.

places.name: Pelican Arms
places.note: Mint-green, three floors, a pool that's mostly leaves.

places.name: Starfish Court
places.note: Bungalows around a parking lot.

places.name: Tideline Beach
places.note: The long beach below the hotels. The wrack line is where the city's secrets come back.

places.name: Lifeguard Tower 4
places.note: Where the current hooks into the beach. Things that go in off Port Salt come up here.

places.name: The Bandshell
places.note: A concrete bandshell on the sand. Summer concerts, winter pigeons.

places.name: Tideline Pier
places.note: The long fishing and amusement pier at the south end of Tideline Avenue.

places.name: Ruelas Bait & Ice
places.note: Dez's shop at the end of Tideline Pier. Bait, ice, a walk-in cooler and a back door onto the water.

places.name: Penny Arcade
places.note: Shuttered arcade halfway down Tideline Pier.

places.name: Bar Road Landing
places.note: Tideline's east end, where the Bar Road leaves the beach at low water.

places.name: The Third Bench
places.note: Third bench from the founder's statue. Pruitt's office, unofficially.

places.name: Founder's Statue
places.note: Josiah Marlowe in bronze, facing the mainland.

places.name: The Fountain
places.note: Dry since the drought of 2009. There is a plaque about it.

places.name: Domino Tables
places.note: Concrete tables under the banyan. The old men here know everything a day early.

places.name: Breakwater Diner
places.note: Open 24 hours. Cops at the counter, nurses in the booths.

places.name: Keys Transit Depot
places.note: The bus depot.

places.name: Midtown Underpass
places.note: Where the boulevard dips under the old rail embankment. No cameras, no shoulder.

places.name: Saint Brendan's Hospital
places.note: Where you wake up after you wash up.

places.name: Public Safety Central Station
places.note: Headquarters. Where you end up after you're netted.

places.name: Coral Theater
places.note: Old movie palace. The marquee has said CLOSED FOR SEASON for eleven years.

places.name: Banyan Street
places.note: Quiet street of stucco houses. Commissioner Moss lives at the end.

places.name: Calder Street
places.note: Bars, a laundromat, a pawn shop, double parking.

places.name: Meridian Tower
places.note: Tallest glass on the island. Ashby Tidewater has the top six floors.

places.name: Port Salt Commons Sales Gallery
places.note: Ground floor of the Meridian Tower. A scale model of the waterfront with nobody on it.

places.name: Meridian Tower Garage
places.note: Valet on level one. Everybody else below.

places.name: Halyard Avenue
places.note: The main avenue of towers. Locals call it the Glass Mile.

places.name: The Old Customs House
places.note: Coral-stone building between two towers. City Hall and the Port Commission meet here.

places.name: Northpoint Marina
places.note: Yachts, a fuel dock and the Gilded Gull's berth.

places.name: The Fair Weather
places.note: Calvin Ashby's yacht at Northpoint Marina. It has never been past the Knuckle.

places.name: Bellwether Bridge
places.note: The private bridge to Bellwether Key. A guard hut and a gate arm.

places.name: The Ashby House
places.note: White house on Bellwether Key with a dock, a pool and too many cameras.

places.name: Ashby's Study
places.note: The room with the laptop and the photographs of Calvin with people.

places.name: The Bar Road
places.note: A shell track across the flats from Tideline to the Stilts. Above water for about two hours either side of low tide.

places.name: The Stilts
places.note: Fishing shacks on pilings out on the flats.

places.name: Manny's Shack
places.note: Manny Ruelas's shack on the Stilts. Nobody's been inside for three years.

places.name: Gull Key
places.note: A small mangrove key at the end of the Stilts. Birds and mosquitoes.

places.name: The Knuckle
places.note: The shoal at the mouth of the Marlowe Channel where the Ottoline grounded.

places.name: Manny's Skiff
places.note: Two hundred yards northeast of the Knuckle, under sand and water. Until Saturday.

places.name: Marlowe Channel
places.note: The dredged channel from the sea buoy around the Knuckle into Port Salt.

places.name: Outer Anchorage
places.note: Where ships wait for a pilot. Where eleven boxes went over the side early.
